verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own feedback pipeline sorts incoming submissions as real or spam and noise, and dismisses spam. An agent then reads each real submission, fills in an intention and proposes tasks, which covers the AI-assisted decluttering of raw feedback. Nothing shows Foreloop ranking or aggregating feedback to surface the most impactful opportunities. Missing for 10: impact-based prioritization or ranking across feedback, clustering or aggregation of themes, explicit confirmation that the spam/noise triage is AI-driven, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to declutter raw feedback and surface the most impactful opportunities

citations.quote: real, or spam and noise. Spam is dismissed here and goes no further.
